newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 11.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- Chinese Communist Party issues rules on party discipline, anti-corruption
- President Jiang Zemin to visit Russia
- Retail price inflation 2.6 percent for first quarter
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
ECONOMIC DAILY
- China feed producers buy 4.0 million tonnes of corn from northeast
- 1996 natural rubber output at 420,000 tonnes, synthetic rubber output at 550,000 tonnes
- China plans to produce 440,000 tonnes of natural rubber, 560,000 tonnes of synthetic rubber in 1997
CHINA SECURITIES
- Vice Premier Zou Jiahua says fixed asset investment seen at 2.53 trillion yuan in 1997
- Editorial says China issue of 4.0 billion yuan of convertible bonds is sign of rapid market expansion
FINANCIAL NEWS
- Shenzhen Financing Centre total turnover hit 20.95 billion yuan in first quarter, up by 154.9 percent yr/yr
- Liugang exports 60,000 tonnes of rolled steel and pir iron, earning $8.0 million in first quarter
CHINA BUSINESS DAILY
- Rising demand for safe deposit boxes in banks
ECONOMIC INFORMATION DAILY
- China seen to scrap import restrictions on 385 commodities after entry into World Trade Organisation
MARKET DAILY
- Huludao Zinc Factory makes 240.26 million yuan in pre-tax profits in 1996, plans to list on domestic stock market
- China demand for mini-cars seen at 110,000 tonnes in 1997
CHINA DAILY
- President Jiang Zemin says backs Middle East peace process
- Vice Premier Li Lanqing says China to spend billion of dollars on infrastructure projects before end of century
- Cities help their poor with new aid scheme
- Trade Minister Wu Yi warns against regional protectionism around world
